title: Invalid language code on part of the page
user_impact: Screen readers cannot switch to the right pronunciation for that passage.
technical_impact: lang below <html> that is not a valid BCP 47 tag and sets the language of text.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.2 Language of Parts; H58; BCP 47 (RFC 5646) primary language subtag; ACT de46e4
checks.applicability: Elements below html with a non-empty lang attribute whose own text (text nodes or a non-empty img alt not claimed by an inner lang) is rendered.
checks.expectation:
Fails when the lang attribute of such an element is not a valid BCP 47 tag
(primary subtag not a language: "dutch", "english", "invalid"): the passage
gets no language, so assistive technology cannot pick the pronunciation 3.1.2
asks for. Reported once, at the element carrying the attribute. Only the
primary subtag has to be valid ("en-US-GB" passes). Text inside an inner
element with its own lang belongs to that lang; an image carries text through
a non-empty alt. Text hidden from the accessibility tree (aria-hidden) is still
drawn and counts; text that is not rendered does not. lang="" states that the
language is unknown and is not a finding; the root element is
document/lang-invalid, not this id.
